concerns.summary: weightLb not validated — NaN/negative corrupts LOAD display
toFixed(1) rounds 0.25 lb to 0.3 lb in display
LOAD denominator shows unburdened cap — numerator exceeds it when encumbered

rounds.adjudication: All three concerns were valid and independently surfaced: (1) Codex: weightLb validation gap — fixed in validateItemDef + defensive guard. (2) Gemini: toFixed(1) precision bug on 0.25 lb values — fixed with formatLb helper. (3) Sonnet: LOAD denominator was unburdened cap rather than max-before-overloaded threshold — fixed to ENCUMBRANCE_HEAVY_FACTOR x cap. No conflicts between reviewers. Suggestion to extract shared unique-instance traversal is valid but not blocking; deferred.
